Author: SorenWolfe
Name: Shikari
Description: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game. Slide-based arena diagrams, per-player cooldown assignments, and shotcall reminders anchored to real boss casts or to timings the plugin learns from your own pulls.
Punchline: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game.

Author: SorenWolfe
Name: Foxtrot
Description: Preview any orchestrion roll before you go and earn it. Right-click a roll in your bags for a small player, or open the browser and search every track in the game — including the ones you do not own yet. The zone music steps aside while you listen and comes back when you stop.
Punchline: Hear an orchestrion roll before you go and earn it.

Author: SorenWolfe
Name: Miyagi
Description: Learn your rotation instead of following a highlight. Shows the next button, then waits for you to hesitate, then says nothing until you get one wrong — and when the pull ends it tells you what it actually cost: uptime, casts you cancelled by moving, cooldowns you held too long. Black Mage at level 100, built from the Balance guide and checked against savage cast logs.
Punchline: A rotation coach that is trying to become unnecessary.
